get_state.doc: The caller's own LAUNCH30 promo state — eligible_unseen | eligible_seen | claimed_active | claimed_expired | ineligible. Read-only, recomputed every call.

dismiss.doc: Record that Modal A was shown/dismissed on this surface, once, forever (server flag, not localStorage).

claim.doc: Claim the 1-month free Team trial: no card, no Stripe object. Bootstraps (or reuses) the caller's organisation, then grants a Team-plan yp.quota row for 30 days.

errors.description: not on Free, or already inside another organisation

redeem.doc: Redeem a free-period MKT partner code straight into a plan — no Stripe Checkout, no card. Only codes with percent_off=0 and trial_days>0 qualify; a discount code has money to collect and must go through checkout. Grants a yp.quota row the expiry worker later reverts (same shape as claim).

plan.doc: Plan to grant (team|business); constrained by the coupon's plan_scope

errors.description: code carries a discount — redeem at checkout, not here
code is locked to a different plan
payer already belongs to another organisation

cancel.doc: End an active LAUNCH30 trial early from Billing. No Stripe object exists — clears the org yp.quota row (same path as promoExpiryWorker) and marks the claim expired. Immediate, not cancel-at-period-end.

errors.description: no claimed_active LAUNCH30 trial for this payer
